title: The Seven Feasts
intro: God gave Israel seven annual feasts. Each points prophetically to Christ and the story of salvation.

items.title: Passover (Pesach)
items.text: Commemorates the exodus from Egypt. The Passover lamb points to Christ, our Passover lamb.

items.title: Feast of Unleavened Bread
items.text: Seven days with unleavened bread. Leaven symbolizes sin - purity in life.

items.title: Firstfruits
items.text: The first sheaf of grain is offered. Christ is the firstfruit of those who have fallen asleep.

items.title: Pentecost (Shavuot)
items.text: 50 days after Passover. The giving of the Law. Fulfilled when the Spirit was poured out on the day of Pentecost.

items.title: Feast of Trumpets (Rosh Hashanah)
items.text: A day of rest with trumpet blasts. Jewish New Year. Points to the return of Christ.

items.title: Day of Atonement (Yom Kippur)
items.text: The holiest day of the year. The high priest entered the Most Holy Place.

items.title: Feast of Tabernacles (Sukkot)
items.text: Seven days in booths. Commemorates the wilderness journey. Points to God dwelling among people.
